verdict: APPROVE — every promise in the B20 brief is real ON PAPER and the blast radius is exactly the enumerated hardware: the CA compose prints tank+pan+stand+strap-band+T&P without clutter (the CA-vs-INTL pixel diff is precisely the 3-leg strap U; INTL ships zero straps anywhere), the takeoff books valve/pan/stand/straps 1/1/1/2 pcs with cites and the discharge rides Copper ¾" lf with EXACT member-sum conservation; the weir→vent flag prints verbatim with the measured 21.3 ft; the island flag composes with ' | ' across the wrap; both shield wordings print distinct; the meter×panel TRADE CLASH riser flag prints verbatim (the ⚠ label is a 3D/inspector surface — fixture labels never typeset, the flag IS the paper story); both F3 exhibits clamp clear (lavc 9.9→9.756, wc22 5.22→5.266 — base geometry was a bare bore into the footing band) and the horizontal-leg tick join works (double-tick + halo'd SLEEVE cite + standing legend row on f3/pinch). Full suite at the pin: 1077 pass / 1 todo / 0 fail (1078 tests, 45 files, 36,896 expects). Three flags travel as queued advisories, none blocking: the dropSleeved fallback is paper-invisible AND un-gated (F5), the new pan/stand steel reaches 4-6 cm into the stud bay extending the pre-existing tank-graze class (F1b), and the T&P discharge resurrects the generic 'supply / DWV pipe' legend row (F1c).

FOCUS-1-wh-assembly-and-takeoff.evidence: cagar (CA) MEP sheet: pan (0.7 sq) / stand (0.66 sq) / tank (0.6 sq) print as clean concentric rects with the strap band as a 3-leg U (wall face → front → wall face) and the T&P valve+discharge as a small stub off the tank — additive detail, zero clutter at 1:100 (crops-pin-wh.png vs crops-base-wh.png: base is a bare buff box). CA-vs-INTL pixel diff of the two MEP sheets in the WH area is EXACTLY the strap U (crops-ca-vs-intl-diff.png); intlgar members carry zero wh-strap-* (diff: +5 members = stand/pan/valve/discharge×2; cagar +11 incl. 6 strap legs). Takeoff on paper (cagar sheet 2/3): 'T&P relief valve — 1 pcs (¾" discharge to ≤6" AFF (P2803.6.1))', 'Water-heater drain pan — 1 pcs', 'Water-heater stand — 1 pcs', 'Seismic straps — 2 pcs (tank upper+lower thirds (P2801.8))'; INTL sheet prints NO strap row. Discharge books as ordinary pipe: Copper ¾" 33.5→39.2 lf (+5.7 lf = the drawn 0.09 nipple + 1.655 drop), +1 elbow; conservation EXACT on cagar and demo (Copper ¾"/½", PVC 3"/1.5" rows == member sums to 0.1 lf). Discharge bottom = 0.1525 m = 6" AFF exactly. Demo (tankless): valve+discharge only, no pan/stand/straps — matrix honest.
FOCUS-1-wh-assembly-and-takeoff.note: Two riders below (F1b geometry, F1c legend semantics).

FOCUS-1b-pan-stand-in-the-stud-bay.evidence: The tank anchor whOff=0.35 is measured from the wall CENTERLINE, so on the 0.15 m garage wall the tank face already sat 1.2 cm inside the studs (PRE-existing, base-identical). B20's wrappers deepen the bore: cagar members — studs span x ∈ [-0.0623, 0.0623]; wh-stand x ∈ [0.02, 0.68] (4.2 cm into the studs, through the PT sole plate band y 0–0.038); wh-pan x ∈ [0.0, 0.7] (steel to the wall centerline, 6.2 cm into the studs at y 0.407–0.457). 10 AABB overlap pairs vs wall-framing/layers. Un-gated: interpenetration.test.ts scopes MEP out and no equipment-vs-structure scenario exists. On paper it is subtle (the pan edge rides the wall line at 1:100); in 3D X-ray the pan slab will read through the studs.
FOCUS-1b-pan-stand-in-the-stud-bay.note: Root cause is the pre-existing anchor convention (offset from centerline, not the finished face) — fix it ONCE for tank+hardware: whOff ≥ wall.thickness/2 + pan half-margin (or size pan/stand off the tank's three FREE faces only), and queue an equipment-vs-structure SAT scenario. Not blocking: extends a board-queued class (fixture-vs-structure), strap legs correctly TERMINATE at the wall face.

FOCUS-1c-tp-discharge-legend-row.evidence: plumbingPipeColor('wh-tp-discharge') → null, so the discharge prints in the generic slate #8fb0c4 and resurrects the LOD-200 fallback legend row 'supply / DWV pipe' on every WH sheet (pin demo + cagar have it; base neither) beside the fully-classified cold/hot/DWV rows. P2's letter is satisfied (the color has a row); the row NAME is a half-truth on a sheet where every other pipe is classified.

FOCUS-2-weir-vent-and-island.evidence: vent schedules print VERBATIM across the word-boundary wrap: '⚑ TRAP ARM: Lavatory trap weir sits 21.3 ft from its vent — exceeds 5 ft for a 1.25" arm (Table P3105.1); vent closer to the trap' — the measured figure (0.3 m emitted arm + 6.2 m along-wall to the near lav's re-vent = 21.3 ft) with the limit and the Table cite; the near lav (vent carrier) and the exempt-but-measured WC print NO flag (negative controls hold). Arm labels state the basis ('weir→vent ≤ N ft, P3105.1'). island schedules: '⚑ ISLAND VENT: Kitchen sink is an island fixture — island venting required (P3112), not modeled; verify loop vent/AAV with the AHJ | TRAP ARM: … 20 ft … (Table P3105.1)…' — both components COMPOSE with ' | ' and print in full over 3 wrapped lines, no ellipsis.
FOCUS-2-weir-vent-and-island.note: The old fixture→wall measure would have read 0.6 m for the far lav — the printed 21.3 ft is the round's whole point, and it reaches paper intact.

FOCUS-3-shield-cover-flags.evidence: Two distinct wordings, both verbatim on schedules: shieldthin (0.09 m wet partition) — '⚑ SHIELD: 3" DWV stack in a 3.5" wall has 0.27" of cover — it does not fit the stud bay; frame the wet wall 2x6 and add steel shield plates (P2603.2.1)'; vent/island (0.15 m walls) — '⚑ SHIELD: 3" DWV stack sits 1.45" from the wall face (< 1.5") — steel shield plates required (P2603.2.1)'. Negative control: the demo's 0.2 m wet walls (2.44" cover) print NO shield flag — the flagship set stays clean. Both placed-path and room-category-fallback stacks carry the flag (gated).
FOCUS-3-shield-cover-flags.note: The flag fires on every default 0.15 m wet wall by design (the cover story is true there); the physical nail-plate members correctly ride B15.

FOCUS-4-meter-panel-clash.evidence: clash scene (tankless, meter at panelMountU on the longest wall — panel fixture at [5, 1.52, 0.076], meter at the same u): the cold-main RISER carries the flag and schedules print it verbatim across the wrap: '⚑ TRADE CLASH: water meter + cold main sit in the electrical panel's dedicated space (NEC 110.26(E) — no foreign piping over the panel footprint); move the water entry along the wall'. The meter fixture label carries '— ⚠ in panel dedicated space (NEC 110.26(E))' (3D/inspector surface — fixture labels never typeset on sheets; the riser flag is the paper surface, which P4 requires). Parity is structural, not a copy: plumbing imports the SAME placePanelSpot + panelMountU electrical uses, and respects a panel override via overrideWallPoint (gated: override away from the wall clears both label and flag).
FOCUS-4-meter-panel-clash.note: The flag fires on most default composes (both trades genuinely elect the same spot — the honest confession); the spatial reservation that will retire it rides B12/B16 per the checklist row. FOCUS-5-f3-residuals-and-glyph-join.evidence: The two exhibits PASS end-to-end: base f3 members show the corner-flush lav drop at x=9.9 (inside the east frost stemwall band, edge 9.757) and the toilet drop at x=5.22 (inside w_mid's 16" thickened-footing band, edge 5.241) — bare bores; pin clamps them to 9.756 and 5.266 (≥ band + pipe half + 2 cm), the ONLY geometry moves in the 9-scene diff (dwv-trap/branch/main/vent re-anchor, drainage continuity gated in plumbing.safety.test.ts + both interpenetration repros). On paper (f3 MEP, 1:75) the drops read INSIDE the room off both walls, DWV flow arrows intact, and the glyph join WORKS for horizontal sleeved legs: the building drain's stemwall crossing prints the double-tick + halo'd 'SLEEVE (P2603.4)' cite + the standing 'TICKS = SLEEVED CROSSING (P2603.4)' legend row (f3 and pinch sheets). THE GAP: the NEW dropSleeved fallback never reaches paper. pinch exhibit (twin bearing walls 0.45 m apart — clampDropClear exhausts 4 passes): the toilet drop stays at x=5.3 INSIDE wB's footing band, its riser label gains '— sleeved where it crosses concrete (P2603.4)' — but the tick layer's dims[0]>=dims[1] filter excludes vertical members (correctly: a drop crosses no foundation LINE), the arm carrier vanishes for flush fixtures (armPlan < minLen), labels never typeset, and the note is a LABEL not a flag — grep over all 12 pinch sheets: the only P2603.4 marks belong to dwv-main. A drop boring a footing is exactly the crossing an examiner marks, and the model's honesty ('never a silent bare crossing') goes silent at the sheet. The fallback branch is also UN-GATED: plumbing.safety.test.ts and both interpenetration repros exercise clamp-SUCCESS only; no test constructs dropSleeved=true.
FOCUS-5-f3-residuals-and-glyph-join.note: Cheap fix, two halves in one commit: (1) compose the dropSleeveNote into the trap riser's FLAG (flags print verbatim on schedules for free — the roFlag ?? crowd chain has room), and/or print a point-glyph + cite at a dropSleeved drop on the MEP sheet; (2) add the pinched-slot gate (twin bearing walls < 2·need apart → dropSleeved pins true, label + flag pinned, drainage SAT exempt).
